title: WoodStone Mix 듀오 #24 · hourglass bombshell / BBW bombshell · 석재 travertine / 목재 zebrawood · 아트리움 · 비주얼계 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side.

#1: a warm golden-brown complexion, mid 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight chestnut brown hair
#1: Body Art: full body polished travertine fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm cream travertine surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID tan and brown horizontal banding flowing through every section, with silver filigree inlay curling across the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved travertine.
#1: Cracks: the travertine body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left forearm, and one chipped-off piece at her right calf, where the broken edge reveals the raw rough beige porous stone with a coarse pitted surface and no polish inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the travertine is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#1: Pose: classical contrapposto stance, weight on one leg, one hand holding the other forearm low in front of her hips — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved travertine right down to the shoes.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, carved from the same travertine with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones.

#2: a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long straight auburn hair
#2: Body Art: full body pale golden zebrawood carved directly over her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pale golden zebrawood grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID dark-brown zebra stripes running between the carved sections, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved pale golden zebrawood.
#2: Cracks: the pale golden zebrawood body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left forearm, and one chipped-off piece at her left hip, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the pale golden zebrawood is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
#2: Pose: turned away from the camera, looking back over her shoulder, one hand brushing her hip, the other hanging down — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in tan leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved pale golden zebrawood right down to the shoes.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, carved from the same zebrawood with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Environment: a bright airy glass-roofed atrium with a pale polished floor, a wide staircase with standard-height steps and tall potted trees, filled with soft white daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with the carved material covering every body from the collarbones to the shoes, shoulders, chest, arms and hands included, every element standing in true relief. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
